# Grizzly Kiwi Dev: Agent Rules packs

> Tested Cursor rules (.cursor/rules/*.mdc), AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md templates and prompts that make AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, Windsurf, Copilot) write current code for Next.js, Supabase, FastAPI, React + Vite, Express 5, Tailwind v4, Godot 4, Unity 6 and Unreal Engine 5. Made by Grizzly Kiwi Dev (X: @GrizzlyKiwidev).

## Products
- [Agent Rules Starter (free)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/rdubay): general Cursor rules, Next.js + Supabase rule, Godot 4 GDScript rule (Godot 3 → 4 table), AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md templates, 10 prompts.
- [Agent Rules Starter Pack (US$19 early bird)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/xgdajx): 12 Cursor rules across 9 stacks, testing and git rules, pre-filled AGENTS.md templates, 30 prompts, 3 workflow guides, changelog and tested-with versions.
- [Godot 4 Agent-Ready 2D Platformer Template (US$15; US$9 with code LAUNCH9 until 23 Oct 2026)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/prfejt): typed Godot 4.7 platformer with AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and Cursor rules for the project, agent recipes and prompts, and a one-command headless smoke test. Web demo on [itch.io](https://grizzlykiwidev.itch.io/godot-4-agent-ready-2d-platformer-template).
- [Agent-Ready Game Dev Bundle (US$29)](https://grizzlykiwi.gumroad.com/l/jhzfba): the Agent Rules Starter Pack plus the Godot 4 platformer template.

## FAQ
- Why is Cursor ignoring my rules? Rules must be .mdc files in .cursor/rules/ with valid frontmatter: alwaysApply: true loads every time, globs attach when matching files are in context, description-only rules load when the agent judges them relevant, and rules with none apply only when @-mentioned. Keep globs relative to the project root and rules short and specific. Rules apply to Agent chat and inline edits, not Tab autocomplete.
